commit.message:
Prohibit third-party notetaker bots in community meetings (#3457)

Add a Community Meetings section to the Code of Conduct directing
participants to the official Google Meet transcription and prohibiting
third-party AI notetakers, meeting bots, and unofficial recording tools.
Reference the policy from the WG/IG meeting requirements.
